official_update.servicing_signature_verification: Windows servicing verifies MSU catalog signatures

observations: Both official update packages were verified, servicing completed, and the guest actually ran build 26200.9711.
Copied Python imported ctypes, socket and ssl successfully.
The unelevated ordinary-user launcher ran in compartment 2 and read the fixed HTTP response through the relay.
The fixed executor probe selected base-container, reported the API present, and did not require DACL augmentation.
The executor then exited 1 without a recorded actor, child, proxy request or browser rendering.
The outer job emptied and temporary account/profile cleanup succeeded.
limits: This is a failed functional experiment, not evidence that PSEC provides the required privacy or service boundary.
Published executor diagnostics contain only categories, codes and a hash, so the exact startup error remains undetermined.
The absence of an actor report cannot distinguish actor startup failure from failure to publish its report.
No DNS/service isolation validation or visible browser acceptance was reached.
The old media and official cumulative update path was tested; a newer ISO has not yet been executed.
